# porch_identity_provider (Resource)

An upstream identity provider (Google or generic OpenID Connect) users sign in with. Installation-wide; requires an installation `admin` token. The client secret is write-only in Porch: it is kept in state from configuration and never read back.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "porch_identity_provider" "google" {
  slug          = "google"
  kind          = "google"
  name          = "Google"
  client_id     = "1234567890-abc.apps.googleusercontent.com"
  client_secret = var.google_client_secret
  allowed_hds   = ["smith.example"] # Google Workspace domains; omit to accept any account
}

resource "porch_identity_provider" "keycloak" {
  slug          = "keycloak"
  kind          = "oidc"
  name          = "Keycloak"
  issuer        = "https://sso.example.com/realms/home"
  client_id     = "porch"
  client_secret = var.keycloak_client_secret
  scopes        = "openid email profile"
}

variable "google_client_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "keycloak_client_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Register this redirect URI at Google.
output "google_callback_url" {
  value = porch_identity_provider.google.callback_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) OAuth client ID registered at the provider.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OAuth client secret (write-only in Porch; changing it rotates the stored secret).
- `kind` (String) `google` or `oidc`. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `name` (String) Display name shown on the sign-in page.
- `slug` (String) URL-safe identifier used in the callback URL (`/login/<slug>/callback`). Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `allowed_hds` (Set of String) Google Workspace domains accepted (`google` only; empty = any account).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the provider is offered at sign-in. Default `true`.
- `issuer` (String) OpenID issuer URL. Defaults to `https://accounts.google.com` for `google`; required for `oidc`.
- `scopes` (String) Space-separated scopes requested upstream (must include `openid`). Default `openid email profile`.

### Read-Only

- `callback_url` (String) Redirect URI to register at the upstream provider.
- `id` (String) Provider ID (`idp_…`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import porch_identity_provider.google idp_01h...   # provider ID or slug (client_secret is not imported)
```
